name: Speed of light in vacuum, exact SI value (c = 299 792 458 m/s)

source.located: The defining statement is the SI (17th CGPM 1983 metre redefinition; retained as a defining constant in the revised SI of 20 May 2019). The SI Brochure / CGPM resolutions are not on arXiv. READ at source here: CODATA 2022, Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga, arXiv:2409.03787 (30 Aug 2024), Table XXXII p.50 and Table XXXIII p.51 ('speed of light in vacuum c 299 792 458 m s^-1 exact'), p.60 ('these four constants were already exactly known as a result of the 1983 redefinition of the meter in terms of an exact value of c and the 2019 revision of the SI'), p.65 list of symbols ('c Speed of light in vacuum and one of the seven defining constants of the SI').
source.via: CODATA 2022 (arXiv:2409.03787) restates the SI definition exactly; the 1983 CGPM resolution and the 2019 SI Brochure themselves are NAMED-NOT-READ.

published_statement: CODATA 2022, Table XXXII (p.50): 'speed of light in vacuum  c  299 792 458 m s^-1  exact'. p.60: c, h, e, k, N_A are 'exactly known as a result of the 1983 redefinition of the meter in terms of an exact value of c and the 2019 revision of the SI'. The same table: G = 6.674 30(15) x 10^-11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2, u_r 2.2e-5, 'identical to their 2018 values' (p.60).
published_hypotheses: H1 (definitional): the metre is defined by fixing the numerical value of c at 299 792 458 when expressed in m s^-1, the second being defined by the caesium frequency. c therefore carries no uncertainty IN SI UNITS; this is a convention of the unit system, not a measurement.

H2 (physical content, not supplied by the definition): c is the invariant speed of special relativity and the vacuum speed of light; that real electromagnetic signals propagate at c requires vacuum, a massless photon and no vacuum dispersion -- empirical propositions tested separately (e.g. LHAASO GRB 221009A time-of-flight, arXiv:2402.06009).
H3: exactness is relative to the SI; in geometric units (the tree's derivations) c = 1 by convention and the SI value enters only on conversion to metres/seconds/joules.
hypothesis_drift: NONE on the value: nonstatic.py:253 'C = 2.99792458e8  # m/s, exact' and transit.py:142 'C_SI = 2.99792458e8' are the SI value exactly (Fraction(literal) == 299792458), and the integer is exactly representable in IEEE-754 binary64 (< 2^53), so 'exact' survives into the float -- computed, rederive checks 3-5.

LABEL (canonical, not owner files): the merged key 'si-2019-c' dates the fix to 2019; per the source (CODATA 2022 p.60) c was fixed in 1983 and the 2019 revision retained it. Neither nonstatic.py nor transit.py states a year (grep for 2019/1983/CGPM returns nothing), so this is a labelling discrepancy in the audit's canonical entry, not in the tree.

ADDED physical hypothesis at transit.py:145 ('def arrival_time(D): return D/C_SI  # the classical channel, at c'): the SI definition does not supply that a real classical channel arrives in D/c; that is H2 plus a vacuum path. A real radio channel through the interstellar plasma is SLOWER (cold-plasma group delay >= 0; computed 0.054/0.540/5.40 ms at 1 GHz over Earth-Proxima for assumed n_e = 0.01/0.1/1 cm^-3 -- n_e not read at source). Direction: this can only make advantage_over_light <= 0, i.e. it does not move the tree's 'no advantage over light' conclusion; it is an idealisation erring toward the channel, not against the tree.

OBSERVATION (not a drift of c): transit.py:146 advantage_over_light(D) = arrival_time(D) - D/C_SI with arrival_time(D) = D/C_SI is an identity for ANY c > 0 (sympy: D/c - D/c = 0; float: bit-exact 0.0 at all four DISTANCES). The printed 0.000 therefore tests nothing about c; it records the channel model. The canonical hypothesis 'cancels identically in advantage_over_light' is accurate.

nonstatic.py:256 'LY = 9.4607304725808e15  # m, exact (Julian year x c)': computed 365.25 x 86400 x 299792458 = 9 460 730 472 580 800 exactly, equal to the literal and exactly representable in binary64 (even, < 2^54). No drift.

data_at_publication.moves_conclusion: No. A defined constant cannot move; zero uncertainty by construction.

rederivation.outcome: ALL PASS (22 checks). Owner literals equal the SI integer exactly as rationals; exact in binary64; LY literal = Julian-year x c exactly; advantage_over_light is an identity for any c (symbolic) and bit-exact 0.0 in float at all four DISTANCES; nonstatic.band_ratio is independent of c (d/dc = 0) and equals 2 eps W/sqrt(W^2-1); build_energy scales as c^4 so c contributes zero uncertainty; tree G literal equals CODATA 2022 G; transit's Earth-Proxima 4.0175e16 m agrees with nonstatic PROXIMA_LY*LY to 2e-7; cold-plasma dispersion constant from CODATA 2022 constants reproduces 4.149 ms/(pc cm^-3) at 1 GHz and is positive (channel only slower).

Assumes flat LCDM (H0 67.36, Om 0.315), z = 0.151, EBL model; EBL extremes move eta_1 limits by up to 18%. Supports H2 (photons propagate at c) to a level irrelevant to the tree.

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested for this result: there is no 'data the authors lacked' for the value -- since 1983 c is a definition, so no future measurement can change 299 792 458 m/s; a better measurement would redefine the realised metre, not c. Evidence: CODATA 2022 lists it 'exact' with no uncertainty column (p.50) and excludes it from the 2018->2022 comparison because it is exactly known (p.60). The physical content the tree also leans on (transit.py:145, 'the classical channel, at c') is empirical and has been tested with data unavailable in 1983: LHAASO 2024 bounds any vacuum-dispersion speed deviation to <= 4e-35 of c for a GHz photon (computed from the read E_QG,1 bound). The one datum the tree does not model -- plasma along a real path -- makes signals slower, never faster, so the tree's no-advantage conclusion is unchanged either way. Having more data does not change the conclusion.
grade_evidence: Value and 'exact' status READ at CODATA 2022 (arXiv:2409.03787 Table XXXII p.50, p.60); owner literals nonstatic.py:253 and transit.py:142 equal it exactly and survive binary64 exactly; the uses resting on it (band_time_seconds, crossing_time_seconds, build_energy, band_ratio, transit D23 advantage_over_light) were re-derived symbolically and numerically with 22/22 checks passing; no datum can move a defined constant. Recorded, not repaired: (i) the canonical merged key 'si-2019-c' mis-dates the fix (1983, retained 2019) -- a label discrepancy outside the owner files; (ii) transit.py:145 adds the physical hypothesis that a classical channel runs at c, which the definition does not supply, but every correction to it (medium dispersion) is one-signed toward slower and cannot move the tree's conclusion; (iii) advantage_over_light is an identity, so its 0.000 is a statement of the model, not a test of c.
what_would_change_the_grade: Nothing about the value can: only a CGPM redefinition of the SI that unfixed c would, and none exists (CODATA 2022). The ADDED hypothesis at transit.py:145 would become NARROWED only if the tree used 'arrival at D/c' as a physically achieved time (rather than an upper bound on any channel's speed) in a conclusion that needed equality -- it does not, as advantage_over_light is defined to be zero. A detected superluminal vacuum dispersion at radio frequencies of order >1e-12 would reopen H2; the read bound is 4e-35.
